title: Better Editing & Timezone Fixes
summary: Edit visits with the same smooth multi-step experience, dates now work correctly across all timezones, and loading states show helpful animations.
features: Multi-step visit editing: Edit visits in 2 easy steps (Edit Items → Update Ratings) matching the Add Visit flow
Browser back button support: Navigate between edit steps using your browser's back button
Auto-save edit progress: Your edits are saved as you make changes - never lose your work
improvements: Loading spinners: See animated spinners when the app is loading so you know it's working
Better date handling: Dates now display in your local timezone and work correctly when traveling
Consistent navigation: Edit Visit now follows the same patterns as Add Visit
Cleaner headers: Simplified page headers across Settings and What's New pages
fixes: Fixed dates showing wrong day in some timezones
Fixed date picker showing different date than displayed date when editing
Fixed edit page getting stuck on loading screen after refresh

title: Multi-Step Visit Creation & Smarter Menu Scanning
summary: Adding visits is now easier with three clear steps, and menu scanning is smarter - it checks if your photo is actually a menu before processing.
features: Multi-step visit creation: Add visits in 3 easy steps (Select Restaurant → Add Items → Rate Items)
Auto-save progress: Never lose your work - your progress saves automatically as you go
Smart menu validation: App now checks if your photo is a menu before processing it
Daily scan limit: 5 menu scan attempts per day to prevent accidental overuse
improvements: Faster feedback: Get instant feedback if uploaded photo isn't a menu
Better error messages: Clearer explanations when something goes wrong
fixes: Fixed app uploading non-menu photos to storage

title: Improved Restaurant Search
summary: Restaurant search is now more reliable with better performance and security improvements.
improvements: More reliable restaurant search with improved performance
fixes: Fixed restaurant search not working for some users

title: Streamlined Search Experience
summary: Restaurant search is now simpler with unified filtering and cleaner notifications.
features: Unified search: All restaurants (saved and new) now search and filter together
Auto-dismiss notifications: Success messages automatically disappear after 3 seconds
improvements: Simplified search: Single filter input now works for all restaurants
Better notifications: Floating success messages instead of static banners
Cleaner interface: Removed duplicate search inputs
fixes: Fixed search filter not working on newly found restaurants
Fixed Clear Search Results button not resetting notifications

title: Search, Pagination & UI Improvements
summary: Major updates including visit search, page-by-page restaurant browsing, more food places, and numerous UI improvements.
features: Search your visits: Find visits by restaurant name, location, food items, or notes
Page-by-page navigation: Browse restaurant results with page numbers (<< < 1 2 3 4 5 > >>)
More food places: Search now includes cafes, bakeries, coffee shops, dessert shops, ice cream shops, and more
What's New notifications: Get notified about app updates (shows once per version)
Quick add button: 'Add Your First Visit' button appears when you have no visits
improvements: Feedback button moved to header for easier access
Settings page footer now visible for consistent navigation
Notification badges update instantly when you read feedback
Visit search auto-expands matching months for better visibility
Larger search radius (5km) to find more restaurant options
Search inputs stay visible after getting results for easy refinement
Clear result counts shown for searches
fixes: Settings back button now correctly returns to Profile page
Feedback notification badge updates immediately after reading
Search now properly includes all food establishment types
Pagination resets correctly when starting a new search

title: Welcome to Track Your Foods
summary: The initial release brings you a comprehensive food tracking experience with social features, location-based restaurant search, and privacy controls.
features: Track restaurant visits with ratings, notes, and photos
Find nearby restaurants using GPS or search by location
Rate food items with 5-star system ("Don't eat ever" to "Eat often")
Scan menu photos to automatically extract menu items
Add friends via QR codes or friend codes to share your food experiences
View friends' visits on your home feed (respecting privacy settings)
Control visit visibility - share with friends or keep private
Submit feedback and feature requests directly in the app
Invite-only system - first user can generate invite codes for friends
Chronological home feed grouped by month and day
Search restaurants by name, location, or cuisine type
Edit or delete your visits anytime
Customize profile with name and manage account settings
